title: Terminal UI Rendering Instability in VSCode with Multiple Panes
body:
**Bug Description**
Claude Code UI Jumping and Skipping when using multiple terminals under each other:

In many cases when the text overfloats (when using multiple terminals on the right in visual studio code in a fish shell,  (especially when i paste code) the UI jumps up and down (during the the answer of the AI), this only stops when i change the size of the integrated terminal (sometimes). Even worse: sometimes the whole IDE crashes because of this bug.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: vscode + fish shell
- Version: 1.0.43
- Feedback ID: d69be45a-e387-4210-828d-163b2e4d3bb0
author: 2mawi2
